rules.name: Shallow Drafts
rules.description: All Swedish Medium ships or small ignore the terrain rules for sandbanks and shoals/shorelines

rules.name: Carlskrona
rules.description: The Carlskrona does not have to spend a full Turn without shooting to switch from oars to sails. At the start of the ship's activation, decide what movement it will use, then use that until the ship's next activation.

rules.name: Admiral Johan af Puke
rules.description: Once per Turn, a ship carrying af Puke can re-roll a single dice, for any reason. The player must accept the second result.
